title: Shared folder browsing and notifications
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-app --features ui,pdfium; A-02, A-11
notes: Split out of T-0221 round A, which delivered A-03, A-04, A-07..A-10 and A-12 but not notifications or the shared folder; those two acceptance items stay open until this task lands. A-02: the bell lists real local events only (document saved, export finished, signature request returned later), a capped list, a popover and an honest empty state; no fabricated or demo events. A-11: the shared folder is configured in settings, lists PDFs and XFDF review files from it, and opens them; file-system semantics only, with no network assumptions and no sync protocol. Both are app-lane work and serialise behind T-0221.
